title: Right in town, right on the water
body: Park once, walk down to the water, and be on the lake in minutes. We'll get you set up in the right boat and send you off.

seasons.title: Quiet mornings
seasons.line: Calm water and the park to yourself before the town wakes up.

seasons.title: Pick your boat
seasons.line: Kayaks, paddle boards, hydro bikes and more, all at the dock.

seasons.title: Color on the water
seasons.line: Open until mid-October, when the hills turn.
